1.consolidated_definition: Pez marino de hasta 50 cm de longitud, de cuerpo ovalado, con escamas de varios colores, con el predominio del azul, cabeza pequeña y ojos grandes, con su pico córneo, robusto y prominente, parecido al del loro. Scaridae, Sparisoma coeruleus.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Marine fish reaching up to 50 cm in length, with an oval body, featuring scales of various colors, predominantly blue, a small head and large eyes, along with its keratinous beak, robust and prominent, resembling that of a parrot. Family Scaridae, Sparisoma coeruleus.
